head: 77b69fb28694283279f3e8cbc75e84a95c5b123d
scope: Default PR CI; optional install and SFW jobs skipped as on unlabeled PRs.
controls: Identical source, toolchain, dependency pins and runner labels.
Same branch; both variants restore the same immutable production cache keys from main.
Cold: no Cargo, pnpm, SDK or native binary cache restore or save.
No primer needed: exact matching main caches already exist. Duplicate benchmark caches were evicted and that trial was excluded.
Warm: exact cache hits required; all saves disabled. Cache inventories and restored keys are retained as evidence.
Zig action cache disabled for all runs.
Hosted image/tool download caches and public network services are not controlled.
